method: Read-only in-memory calls to the current trading calendar, market_archive.completed_day and execution_bars.load_execution_bars with an explicit simulated 2026-10-08 07:30 Asia/Shanghai clock; no archived bar fetch or account write.

observations.paper_decision_policy: A plan dated 2026-10-08 with data_asof=2026-09-30 is eligible for 2026-10-08, but actual Paper execution still requires the completed execution session and evidence.

limits: This confirms deterministic date and preclose guards, not that the October 8 market feed, archive, six reviews, orders, fills or notification will succeed. The local calendar and exchange session must be rechecked on the actual day.
next_boundary: Before 09:15 only accept actual same-version publication and six independent reviews. After the true October 8 close and complete archive, independently finalize plan_hash-bound decisions, both Paper accounts, three-way comparison and authorized notification; never backdate or manufacture a preclose fill.
